name: What factors influence the longevity of a bathroom tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What factors influence the longevity of a bathroom tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Several factors contribute to how long a bathroom tile installation will last. Proper subfloor preparation, including waterproofing in wet areas, is paramount. The quality of materials, such as tiles, adhesive, and grout, also plays a significant role. Correct installation techniques, including proper spacing and leveling, are crucial. Finally, ongoing maintenance and cleaning help preserve the appearance and integrity of the tiles and grout over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Longevity depends on proper subfloor preparation, quality materials, correct installation techniques, and consistent maintenance. Waterproofing in wet areas is key.
